note: The player's lines (GROUND_SYSTEMS.md §3.2): one for every answer code (Hollow.Simulation's OutcomeCode, by name), the one place the interface looks and the one file a translation translates. Not in the game data's hash: texts change nothing in the rules. A line may name the answer's detail: {n} is its number, {item} the name of the item it names, in lower case ({item|word}: the word when it names none). The content check makes sure every code has a line and every line a code.

outcomes.NotOwner: Only its owner can do that
outcomes.CantStart: It can't start with what's in it
outcomes.NotLanded: Land first: you can only step out of a ship at rest
outcomes.NeedsEarlierNode: Unlock one of the nodes before it first
outcomes.NotLeader: Only the team's leader can do that
outcomes.NoSocket: Aim at the ground or at a building socket
outcomes.BuildingBlocked: Building blocked: someone else's tool cupboard
outcomes.Floating: The foundation would float: the ground is too far below
outcomes.Buried: The foundation would be buried: the ground is too high
outcomes.HitsPiece: It would cut into another piece
outcomes.HitsGround: It would cut into the ground
outcomes.PlayerInTheWay: A player is in the way
outcomes.TooManyPieces: This building can't grow any bigger
outcomes.JoinsClaims: That would join two claimed buildings
outcomes.NotAuthorised: You have no building rights here
outcomes.EditWindowOver: Too late: pieces can be rotated or demolished only for 10 minutes after placing
outcomes.NotHigherGrade: Already at this grade or stronger
outcomes.NotAnOpening: Aim at a doorway or a wall frame
outcomes.NeedsWallFrame: This door needs a wall frame
outcomes.HasLock: There's a lock on it already
outcomes.WaitForCode: Wait {n} s before trying another code
outcomes.HasClaim: This building has a tool cupboard already
outcomes.NotOnStructure: Place it on a foundation or a floor
outcomes.NotOnLock: You aren't authorised on this lock
outcomes.Misplaced: It doesn't fit there any more: aim again
outcomes.Overhangs: It would hang over the edge
outcomes.StructureFull: This building can't hold another {item|one of these}
outcomes.TooMany: You can't place another {item|one of these}
outcomes.InWater: It can't go in the water
outcomes.TooLate: Too late: the connection is slow
outcomes.RampBlocked: Ramp blocked: someone is in the way
